messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — rolling autoscale policy update for the `sundial` GPU pool tonight at 22:30 PT. Minimally disruptive: no model swap, just autoscale params (min 1 -> 2, max 6 -> 12) + enable burst. Canary on slice A first. Who can own smoke + rollback readiness?

maria_s: I can own smoke and rollback. I’ll be on-call 22:10–23:00. Smoke checklist I’ll run: 1) `redwoodctl pool describe sundial` 2) run `rtest --suite smokes/sundial` 3) verify p50/p95 and token throughput in Console.

jonah_r: I’ll monitor infra metrics and SLOs. I’ll have the GPU dashboard and allocator traces open. If allocation latency > 200ms or OOM rate spikes, I’ll flag.

linda_ops: I’ll be standby for rollback ops. Rollback plan (short): revert autoscale policy to previous JSON, scale max back to 6, drain new nodes from slice A, and re-run smoke. Command snippets:
```
# rollback quick commands
redwoodctl autoscale set --pool sundial --min 1 --max 6 --policy previous-policy.json
redwoodctl pool scale --pool sundial --max 6
redwoodctl pool drain --pool sundial --selector slice=A --timeout 300s
```
I’ll also open a rollback ticket in PagerDuty if we breach escalation.

deploybot: Deployment queued by alex_k — id=deploy-3124000000-01, scheduled=2026-03-17T22:30:00Z, mode=canary-slice-A. Please ack.

alex_k: acked. Plan: kick canary at 22:30, wait 10m, if no regressions promote to full rollout (target 22:45). If any of the smoke checks fail or Jonah sees metric regressions, rollback immediately.

maria_s: Got it. I’ll post short smoke results here at 22:40 (latency p50/p95, token/sec, any error spikes). Also will run the load snippet:
```
# quick load to validate scaling
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}' & done
```

jonah_r: FYI I’ll watch allocator logs for KV-cache pressure and also keep an eye on pod churn. If churn > 3 nodes/min we hold.

alex_k: thanks team. tagging @maria_s @jonah_r @linda_ops — I’ll be on standby in case we need to escalate. :thumbsup:

maria_s: :thumbsup: will update with results.
